user.title: Statens vegvesen DATEX account
user.description: Vegvarsel reads Statens vegvesen's official traffic messages (DATEX II). Access is free, but you have to request a username and password first: {access_url}

data_description.url: Leave as it is. Only for the demo feed (tools/demo_feed.py) or a mirror.

reauth_confirm.description: Statens vegvesen no longer accepts the password for {username}.

data_description.scan_minutes: Vegvarsel also checks at the exact minute a watch window opens and an evening preview is due, whatever this is set to.

vias.title: Via points ({count})
vias.description: The route is worked out as the fastest drive. If you take another road, add a point on it so the route follows it.

review.title: The route
review.description:
{start} → {destination} ({vias} via points): {km} km, about {minutes} min without traffic.

Check it is the road you drive: [open on OpenStreetMap]({map_url})

settings.title: When do you drive it?
settings.description: Vegvarsel tells you about what lies over your next trip. Live alerts are sent inside the watch windows, a summary when each window opens, and an optional preview the evening before.

data_description.corridor_m: How far from the route a traffic message may be and still count.
data_description.windows: One window per field, as HH:MM-HH:MM (e.g. 06:30-08:00); use “Add” for another. Start the window when you would want to know before leaving. Leave empty to watch around the clock.
data_description.preview: Leave empty for no evening preview.

data_description.recalculate: Asks the route planner again with the same start, via points and destination.
